description: WSO2 SAP SuccessFactors Job Application provides a way to interact with the [SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting APIs](https://api.sap.com/package/SuccessFactorsRecruiting/overview). The service allows to query and manage job applications, and to assess applicants through comments, status changes, assessments and background checks.
key-features: Create, update and query job applications
Track application statuses and their audit trail
Access assessment orders, assessment reports and background check results
